title: Job Details

fields.label: Reference Number
fields.name: kwv_career_reference
fields.instructions: The job's reference number, e.g. BMMS0128. Shown on the listing and recorded against each application.

fields.label: Location
fields.name: kwv_career_location
fields.instructions: Where the role is based, e.g. Paarl, Western Cape.

fields.label: Department
fields.name: kwv_career_department
fields.instructions: The department the role sits in, e.g. Sales & Marketing.

fields.label: Closing Date
fields.name: kwv_career_closing_date
fields.instructions: After this date the job automatically moves to Draft and drops off the listing. It stays live on the closing day itself. Leave blank for no closing date.

fields.label: Application Form
fields.name: kwv_career_form_id
fields.instructions: Choose the Gravity Forms form to embed on this job. Leave blank to use the shared "KWV Job Application" form.

description: Custom fields for the Careers (kwv_career) post type. Managed as code in the KWV Enhancements plugin's /acf-json directory.
